segments.en: Be strong and strong — and trust in Hashem — for He will not abandon you — through the power of the Tzadik who transforms everything for good.

…Who sharpened his wisdom and his intellect — to recognize and to attain the true truth. And who devotes himself to death for the sake of the love and the attachment to the true Tzadik — the pure and the lustrous — the pure and the polished.
